record.question: Who is responsible for preparation of an SOP (Standard Operating Procedure) in a community pharmacy?
options: Joint Director, Food& Drugs, H&FW Department
Joint Director, Government Central Medical Store
record.explanation: Answer B: Pharmacist. The pharmacist-in-charge is responsible for ensuring pharmacy procedures are established and followed; the pharmacist is the best listed responsible person for SOP preparation. Source/context note: Exact assignment of SOP authorship is a local quality-system responsibility. Reference: https://www.indiacode.nic.in/bitstream/123456789/19158/1/2016drugsandcosmeticsact1940rules1945.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
